high_level_description: stc brand style, a business meeting of three professionals seated at a conference table with coffee.

compositional_deconstruction.background: A modern office with a light-colored wall, a green potted plant, and a metallic floor lamp casting warm lighting.

elements.desc: A man wearing a traditional red and white checkered keffiyeh and white traditional Arabic clothing, seated on the left.
A man wearing a dark business suit, seated in the center.
A woman wearing a white hijab and dark business attire, seated on the right.
